title: Scriptura Claim
description: A claim-bearing record. Normative source: BKB-DATA-001 sections 2 and 9. Layer, provenance and non_authoritative are always present. There is no default layer.

non_authoritative.description: Mandatory. Always true for ai_hypothesis. Never omitted at any presentation boundary.

confidence.description: Mandatory on derived claims. In [0,1]. Derived from the evidence chain, never asserted.

verification_state.description: Normative source: BKB-VERIFY-001 section 3. Default is unverified.

layer_fields.description: Per-layer required fields. See BKB-DATA-001 section 2.2. Validated per layer by the application and by SQL CHECK constraints.
